mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 4.0% (based on 3-year rolling window IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through heightened risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS crosses 5.0% in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises simultaneously (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a 1-month decline in retail sales exceeding 0.5% signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days through earnings downgrades.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS falls > 0.5% during late-cycle expansion (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through improved earnings visibility and capital expenditure.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month decline in housing starts below 1500 thousand units signals deteriorating residential construction, reducing consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days through sector-specific sell-offs.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls < 1500.0 in 1 month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 4.0%), a 1-month decline in federal funds rate signals dovish policy pivot that boosts equity risk appetite, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through yield curve steepening.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.2% in 1 month (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate capital expenditure and profit visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days through sector-wide earnings revisions.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls < 100.0 in 1 month (t-test p > 0.05).
